title: The Edit and Write PreToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json runs kb_hook.py, which answers nothing there since the headless guard was removed
goal: No PreToolUse hook entry in .claude/settings.json runs kb_hook.py on Edit, Write, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit while kb_hook.py answers none of those events, and the comment in test_kb_lookup.py's test_raw_read_nudge_hook_is_registered_on_bash_and_powershell no longer calls that entry the headless guard's. The settings edit is the operator's (agents-rule).

run: import json, sys; h = json.load(open(".claude/settings.json", encoding="utf-8"))["hooks"].get("PreToolUse", []); sys.exit(any("Edit" in e.get("matcher", "") and any("kb_hook.py" in x.get("command", "") for x in e.get("hooks", [])) for e in h))
